mentions.name: Egg Explorer
mentions.description: A site for comparing chicken breeds: it shows the different characteristics of chickens, which hatcheries sell each breed, and which hatcheries sell hatching eggs for each breed.
mentions.problem: The author lacked a resource like this when building out their own flock of chickens.
mentions.audience: People building out flocks of chickens
mentions.source_excerpt: My other project is https://eggexplorer.com This is a site I wish I had when building out my flock of chickens. It allows you to see the different characteristics of chickens and which hatcheries sell each different breed. You can also see which hatcheries sell hatching eggs for each breed as well.
